# Check the complete 1:1 Kestrel Runner spot

> Check the 1080x1080 contact sheet's duration, fps, timed three-shot composition, text, price, button, and framing.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=1x1 in the browser and reach the ready 1:1 Kestrel Runner contact sheet.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-22, ac-1, ac-2, ac-3, ac-4, ac-5

On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the header's measured dimensions, frame rate, duration and listed shot boundaries, then assert it reports 1080x1080 pixels, 30 fps, 12 seconds, shot 1 at 0:00–0:03, shot 2 at 0:03–0:07, and shot 3 at 0:07–0:12.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-6, ac-7, ac-8, ac-9

On the 1:1 sheet, compare the shot 1 frames from 0:00 to 0:01 with their layer facts, then assert a teal running shoe with orange sole slides in from the left over a dark night-city background, the shoe is fully inside the frame by 0:01, and the caption reads exactly 'Run the city' and is fully visible by 0:01.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-10, ac-11, ac-12, ac-13, ac-14

On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the shot 2 frames at 0:03, 0:04, 0:05 and 0:06 with their layer facts, then assert the orange-sole close-up retains shot 1's teal-and-orange colourway, the KESTREL wordmark is absent at 0:03 and fully visible by 0:05, and the price tag reads exactly '€149' and is visible at both 0:04 and 0:06.

## Step 5 @verifies ac-15, ac-16, ac-17, ac-18

On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the shot 3 frames and their layer facts from 0:07 through the end of the displayed shot, then assert the headline reads exactly 'Out 28 November', the button reads exactly 'Get early access' and is fully visible by 0:09, and the KESTREL wordmark is visible in every displayed shot 3 frame.

## Step 6 @verifies ac-19

On the 1:1 sheet, inspect the text layers' fully-inside-frame facts for every displayed frame, then assert every displayed text layer stays fully inside the frame.

# Check the wordmark is absent at 0:03 in every cut

> Check the 0:03 frame's wordmark absence in each of the three delivered cuts, separately from the later presence promise.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=16x9 in the browser and reach the ready 16:9 Kestrel Runner contact sheet.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-11

On the 16:9 contact sheet, inspect the 0:03 frame and its KESTREL layer facts, then assert no KESTREL wordmark is visible at 0:03.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-11

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and inspect the ready 9:16 sheet's 0:03 frame and KESTREL layer facts, then assert no KESTREL wordmark is visible at 0:03.

# Check vertical launch-cut reserved bands

> Across the 9:16 contact sheet, prove text and button occupy neither the top 14% nor the bottom 35% of the 1080x1920 frame.

## Step 1

Open {{sheet_url}}?cut=9x16 in the browser and reach the ready 9:16 Kestrel Runner contact sheet.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-23

On the ready 9:16 contact sheet, enable Show safe zones and inspect the text and button layers in every displayed frame against the shaded top 14% band and the facts table, then assert no text or button occupies the top 14% of the frame.

## Step 3 @verifies ac-24

On that 9:16 sheet, inspect every displayed frame and its text and button facts against the shaded bottom 35% band, then assert no text or button occupies the bottom 35% of the frame.

## Step 4 @verifies ac-19

On the 9:16 sheet, inspect the fully-inside-frame fact for each text layer in every displayed frame, then assert every displayed text layer stays fully inside the frame.
